criteria.text: Qdrant reindex jobs, identified by the existing qdrant-reindex- job-id prefix, do not write course-level Stage 2 progress in initialization or any later phase.
Ordinary document-processing jobs retain their existing course-progress writes and all jobs retain BullMQ progress and document/vector processing behavior.
A red-to-green focused regression, the complete Stage 2 unit set, focused format/lint, pnpm type-check, pnpm build, and local graph refresh pass without executing a live reindex.
